entries.title: Revelation of John 2:1
segments: ¶"To the angel of the church of Ephesus write, 'These things says He who holds the seven stars in His right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:2
segments: "I know your works, your labor, your patience, and that you cannot bear those who are evil. And you have tested those who say they are apostles and are not, and have found them liars;

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:3
segments: "and you have persevered and have patience, and have labored for My name's sake and have not become weary.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:4
segments: "Nevertheless I have [this] against you, that you have left your first love.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:5
segments: "Remember therefore from where you have fallen; repent and do the first works, or else I will come to you quickly and remove your lampstand from its place--unless you repent.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:6
segments: "But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:7
segments: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the midst of the Paradise of God."'

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:8
segments: ¶"And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write, 'These things says the First and the Last, who was dead, and came to life:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:9
segments: "I know your works, tribulation, and poverty (but you are rich); and [I know] the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews and are not, but [are] a synagogue of Satan.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:10
segments: "Do not fear any of those things which you are about to suffer. Indeed, the devil is about to throw [some] of you into prison, that you may be tested, and you will have tribulation ten days. Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:11
segments: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes shall not be hurt by the second death."'

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:12
segments: ¶"And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write, 'These things says He who has the sharp two-edged sword:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:13
segments: "I know your works, and where you dwell, where Satan's throne [is]. And you hold fast to My name, and did not deny My faith even in the days in which Antipas [was] My faithful martyr, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:14
segments: "But I have a few things against you, because you have there those who hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:15
segments: "Thus you also have those who hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:16
segments: 'Repent, or else I will come to you quickly and will fight against them with the sword of My mouth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:17
segments: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give some of the hidden manna to eat. And I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows except him who receives [it]."'

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:18
segments: ¶"And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write, 'These things says the Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet like fine brass:

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:19
segments: "I know your works, love, service, faith, and your patience; and [as] for your works, the last [are] more than the first.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:20
segments: "Nevertheless I have a few things against you, because you allow that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, to teach and seduce My servants to commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:21
segments: "And I gave her time to repent of her sexual immorality, and she did not repent.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:22
segments: "Indeed I will cast her into a sickbed, and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of their deeds.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:23
segments: "I will kill her children with death, and all the churches shall know that I am He who searches the minds and hearts. And I will give to each one of you according to your works.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:24
segments: "Now to you I say, and to the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this doctrine, who have not known the depths of Satan, as they say, I will put on you no other burden.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:25
segments: "But hold fast what you have till I come.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:26
segments: "And he who overcomes, and keeps My works until the end, to him I will give power over the nations--

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:27
segments: 'He shall rule them with a rod of iron; They shall be dashed to pieces like the potter's vessels' --as I also have received from My Father;

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:28
segments: "and I will give him the morning star.

entries.title: Revelation of John 2:29
segments: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."'
